blocks.text: Rasulullaah ﷺ Shares some Dates with The Sahabah (RA)

Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) narrates, "Rasulullaah ﷺ once distributed some dates amongst the Sahabah (RA). He gave each person seven dates. I also received seven dates, one of them being without a seed. This was the best of the lot because it was firm and took long to chew."[^1]

Another narration from Hadhrat Anas (RA) states that when some dates were once brought to Rasulullaah ﷺ, he shared it with the Sahabah (RA). Rasulullaah ﷺ was sitting in a squatting position and eating quickly (because he was probably leaving to go somewhere).
The Letter Hadhrat Umar (RA) sent to Hadhrat Amr bin Al Aas (RA) During the Year of Ashes and His Reply

Hadhrat Layth bin Sa'd reports that a severe drought afflicted the people of Madinah during the Khilaafah of Hadhrat Umar (RA), in what was called the Year of Ashes. Hadhrat Umar (RA) wrote the following letter to Hadhrat Amr bin Al Aas (RA) in Egypt.

From the servant of Allaah the Ameerul Mu'mineen
To the sinful son of Aas
Salaams to you. O Amr! I swear by my life that while you and those with you are eating to your fill you seem to have no concern for my companions and I who are on the verge of destruction. Do assist! Do assist!

Hadhrat Amr bin Al Aas (RA) sent the following reply:
To the servant of Allaah Ameerul Mu'mineen
From Amr bin Al Aas
I am at your service! I am at your service! I have dispatched (a train of) camels, the first of which will be by you when the last will still be here with me. Peace be on you as well as Allaah's mercy and blessings.
Hadhrat Umar (RA) Distributes the Food that Hadhrat Amr bin Al Aas (RA) sent Amongst the Residents of Madinah

Hadhrat Amr bin Al Aas (RA) then sent a train of camels so large that when the first camel reached Madinah, the last camel was still leaving Egypt. When the camels arrived, Hadhrat Umar (RA) generously distributed it amongst the people. He gave every household in Madinah a camel with all the food it carried. He appointed Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Auf (RA), Hadhrat Zubayr bin Awwaam (RA) and Hadhrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqqaas (RA) to distribute amongst the people.
